explanation.en:
〜ましょう is a polite way to suggest doing something together. It is similar to “Let’s …” in English. It is made by replacing ます with ましょう.

Key points:
• Verb ます-form → ましょう
• Used to make a suggestion or invitation
• Polite and friendly
• Often followed by よ or ね for tone

For example, “行きます” becomes “行きましょう” (Let’s go). “食べます” becomes “食べましょう” (Let’s eat).

You can use it in daily conversation to propose an action: “一緒に勉強しましょう” means “Let’s study together.”

It is softer than a direct command and sounds cooperative. If you want to be even more gentle, you can add か: “行きましょうか” (Shall we go?).

As a beginner, practice by taking common ます verbs and switching to ましょう. This makes it easy to invite others politely.

examples.japanese: 一緒に勉強しましょう。

commonMistakes.mistake: Using dictionary form + ましょう
commonMistakes.correction: Replace ます with ましょう
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 行くましょう → ✅ 行きましょう

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ましょう as a command
commonMistakes.correction: It is a suggestion, not a strong command
commonMistakes.example: Use a friendly tone when inviting
